answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 492 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the zenith. The dune index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the nadir queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Each impostor pays 12 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
